beta_l_nkids_female.reference: Female singles leisure child-count shifter: certified INTERIOR estimate of the final S8 model (not pinned, not at a bound).

beta_l_nkids_female_se.reference: CR1/HC1 sandwich robust standard error for beta_l_nkids_sf (G_clusters=1555, K_interior=39).

beta_l_nkids_male_historical_test.reference: Male singles child-count shifter: a HISTORICAL, REJECTED test estimate (record_decision=REJECT), not part of the certified 41-parameter S8 vector. final_S8_status: ABSENT; structural zero by the sex-specific shifter specification. Scope caveat: tested on the pre-floor5 frame; no new test performed on the final corrected S8 model.

beta_l_nkids_male_status.reference: Status of the male child-count shifter in the certified S8 model: ABSENT (structural zero).
beta_l_nkids_male_status.value: ABSENT; structural zero by the sex-specific shifter specification

beta_ll_cross_leisure_form.reference: Functional form the (absent) cross-leisure term would take: beta_ll * BoxCox(leisure_male) * BoxCox(leisure_female).

beta_ll_status.reference: Existence status of the beta_ll cross-leisure interaction term: ABSENT from the certified couples spec (non-PD on the joint frame; fixing it moved the weak direction to couples-male leisure).

beta_ll_welfare_effective_value.reference: The effective value the welfare pipeline uses for beta_ll: exactly 0.0, confirmed by absence of a stored interaction_name in build_V (not an estimated-then-zeroed coordinate).

n_params_active.reference: Active singles parameter-vector length (the certified 41-coordinate compact spec); bitwise-equal negLL/gradient to the 51-coordinate form.

n_params_at_bound.column_or_key: prose: '... 10 pinned and 2 free-but-at-a-bound coordinates are held at theta-hat'
n_params_at_bound.reference: 2 of the 41 active parameters are free but sit at an active bound; held fixed at theta-hat during RQMC resampling (39 + 2 = 41).

n_params_interior.column_or_key: prose: 'K = 100 draws ... 39 interior coordinates are drawn'
n_params_interior.reference: Of the 41 active parameters, 39 are interior (drawn under RQMC resampling) and 2 are free-but-at-a-bound.

n_params_provenance.reference: Full 51-coordinate provenance vector = 41 active + 10 dropped/pinned coordinates never consumed by the singles branches (8 inactive couples coordinates + 2 pinned year effects retained as fixed parameters).

n_priced_rows_singles.column_or_key: row_counts.singles (== row_counts.total for this singles-only export)
n_priced_rows_singles.reference: Total priced alternative-rows for the singles estimation sample (1555 x 101 = 157055). This export contains singles only; it is not a combined singles+couples total.

n_regional_environments.reference: Number of distinct regional employment-opportunity environments illustrated for the matched-pair households.

negll_couples_final.reference: Final couples negative log-likelihood, R240 certified estimation.
